summary: The client contacted HomeNet requesting port forwarding for their gaming console due to other providers offering similar services. The agent initially declined but offered to provide instructions through an online guide and login details via email. After the client expressed a desire for more personalized assistance, the agent agreed to send the guidance.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent acknowledged the customer’s request but didn’t offer further assistance or a solution beyond providing instructions.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent used the customer’s name without personalization, failing to establish rapport.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent responded with “I'm not really trained on that part” which demonstrates empathy for the customer’s frustration.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a professional tone despite the initial rejection of the request. [RoBERTa flagged 1 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer’s question ("So who is?") to confirm understanding, showing active listening.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated the customer's name and account details before providing assistance.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked a clarifying question about the gaming console and its purpose, moving beyond simple instructions.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent failed to provide clear expectations regarding the resolution process or next steps.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – While sending the guide, it didn’t offer any troubleshooting tips or guidance on how to resolve the issue.

ratings.name: Took Ownership

ratings.name: Active Listening

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed that the customer’s issue was resolved with the provided guidance.

suggestions: Want: Setting up port forwarding for a gaming console.
Need: Guidance on how to do it.
Check the client’s router admin page and look for “Port Forwarding” or similar settings.
Verify the client has the correct IP address and subnet mask configured in their router.
Send the guide immediately after confirming the client is comfortable with the process.
